name: Jean-Pierre Dubois
bio:
Jean-Pierre's journey into motorsport security began unexpectedly. After a decade in the Royal Canadian Mounted Police, a chance encounter at the Montreal Grand Prix sparked a career change. He quickly recognized the parallels between maintaining order in high-pressure situations and protecting valuable assets in the racing world. 

At Erebus Motorsport, Jean-Pierre is known for his meticulous planning and unwavering dedication. He approaches security not just as a matter of protocols, but as a responsibility to safeguard the team's competitive edge. Jean-Pierre's ability to anticipate potential threats and implement preventative measures, combined with his calm demeanor under pressure, makes him an invaluable asset to the team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave.
physical.description: Jean-Pierre is a tall man with a sturdy build and a serious expression.

quirks: Always carries a small, well-worn copy of the RCMP's field manual.
Insists on conducting a 'perimeter sweep' before any major team meeting.
Has a habit of speaking in police jargon, even when off duty.
